notes: A cheap pipeline case against the shared tinytask fixture, used as the routine-issue case of a paired trial corpus; it stops after test-first, so review, push and ship are never exercised. Case 2 starts at step 6 on a marked-pr sandbox whose setup pushed the branch and opened pull request 7, because the guard lets no sandbox session push or open one; it exempts only the issue claim, and the forge-claim stand-in records any land-lock attempt; it needs the activated home's look-before-merge.md standard, which tree mode does not cover.

evals.name: direct-issue-through-test-first
evals.prompt:
Use the `deliver-direct` skill to deliver `issues/003-mechanical.md`.

Resolve once into a retained ResolvedProject. A resolver refusal is fatal and values are never defaulted or inferred. The tracker capability is unsupported, so this file is the issue: treat it as issue 3 for branch naming, and skip step 1's claim and every tracker call. Work in the worktree step 2 creates.

**Stop after step 3 (Test first).** Commit the change on the worktree branch, report the branch, and stop: no review, no push, no pull request, no merge.
evals.expected_output: A worktree on an `issue-3-<slug>` branch holding one or more commits that rename the flag, with the fixture's tests passing. main is unmoved locally and at origin, nothing is pushed, and no spec or plan is written.

asserts.name: a worktree was created
asserts.shell: [ -n "$WT" ] || fail "no worktree beyond the base checkout"

asserts.name: nothing was pushed
asserts.shell: [ -z "$(git -C "$ORIGIN" for-each-ref --format='%(refname)' refs/heads/ | grep -vx refs/heads/main)" ] || fail "a branch reached origin despite the stop"

asserts.name: local and origin main are unchanged
asserts.shell: { [ "$(git -C "$REPO" rev-parse main)" = "$BASE_MAIN" ] && [ "$(git -C "$ORIGIN" rev-parse main)" = "$BASE_MAIN" ]; } || fail "main moved"

asserts.name: the implementation is committed on the worktree branch
asserts.shell: commits_touch "$WT" tinytask && [ -z "$(git -C "$WT" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all -- tinytask tests README.md)" ] || fail "the implementation in $WT differs from HEAD: it is not all committed"

asserts.name: the renamed flag works through the CLI
asserts.shell: f="$WORK/flagcheck.json"; rm -f "$f"; cli() { (cd "$WORK" && PYTHONPATH="$WT" python3 -m tinytask --file "$f" "$@" 2>&1); }; { cli add x >/dev/null && cli done 1 >/dev/null && [ -z "$(cli list)" ] && [ "$(cli list --include-done)" = "$(printf '1\tdone\tx')" ] && ! cli list --all >/dev/null && cli list --help | grep -q -e --include-done && ! cli list --help | grep -q -e --all; } || fail "the CLI in $WT does not behave as the issue's acceptance criteria say"

asserts.name: the worktree branch is named for issue 3
asserts.shell: git -C "$WT" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^issue-3-' || fail "the worktree branch is not issue-3-<slug>"

asserts.name: the fixture's tests pass in the worktree
asserts.shell: (cd "$WT" && TMPDIR="$WORK" python3 -m unittest discover -q 2>/dev/null) || fail "fixture tests fail in $WT"

asserts.name: no occurrence of the old flag remains
asserts.shell: { [ -z "$(git -C "$WT" grep -n -e '--all' -- tinytask/cli.py README.md)" ] && git -C "$WT" grep -q -e '--include-done' -- tests/test_cli.py; } || fail "the old flag is still named in the implementation or the README, or tests/test_cli.py never exercises --include-done"

asserts.name: no spec or plan was written
asserts.shell: dirs_empty "$WT/${SPEC_DIR#"$REPO"/}" "$WT/${PLAN_DIR#"$REPO"/}" || fail "a spec or plan was written on the direct lane"

evals.name: marked-issue-stops-at-awaiting-look
evals.prompt:
Use the `deliver-direct` skill to deliver issue 3 of `fixture/tinytask` (`issues/003-mechanical.md`).

Resolve once into a retained ResolvedProject. A resolver refusal is fatal and values are never defaulted or inferred. Steps 1 to 5 are done. This sandbox holds no issue claim: skip step 1's issue claim, that is its `forge-claim acquire`, `forge-claim renew` and `forge-claim release`; every other step and command applies as the skill says. The change is implemented, reviewed and verified on branch `issue-3-rename-flag` in its worktree (`git worktree list`), the branch is pushed, and pull request 7 is open for it. Continue at step 6.

**Stop where the skill tells you to stop, and report.** Never close the issue.
evals.expected_output: The session runs `look-approval status` for issue 3, pull request 7 and the branch head, gets `needed`, runs no `forge-claim land` command and merges nothing, and reports the stage awaiting look with issue 3, pull request 7, the head and `issue 3 needs the owner's look before merge`. Nothing is pushed, main is unmoved locally and at origin, the stand-in forge sees no write, and the worktree is kept and clean.

asserts.name: the look was read from the forge
asserts.shell: [ -f "$WORK/gh-calls.jsonl" ] || { fail "the stand-in forge was never called"; exit 1; }; jq -e -s 'def ok(p): any(.[]; .argv[0] == "api" and .exit == 0 and any(.argv[]; test(p))); ok("^repos/fixture/tinytask/issues/3$") and ok("^repos/fixture/tinytask/issues/3/comments([?]|$)")' "$WORK/gh-calls.jsonl" >/dev/null || fail "issue 3 and its comments were not both read: look-approval status never completed"

asserts.name: no land lock was sought
asserts.shell: { [ ! -f "$WORK/forge-claim-calls.jsonl" ] || jq -e -s 'all(.[]; .argv[0] != "land")' "$WORK/forge-claim-calls.jsonl" >/dev/null; } && { [ ! -f "$WORK/gh-calls.jsonl" ] || jq -e -s 'all(.[]; all(.argv[]; test("agent-locks/land") | not))' "$WORK/gh-calls.jsonl" >/dev/null; } || fail "the session sought the land lock: a forge-claim land call or a land lock ref read"

asserts.name: the forge saw no write
asserts.shell: [ ! -f "$WORK/gh-calls.jsonl" ] || jq -e -s 'all(.[]; (.argv[0:2] | IN(["pr","merge"], ["pr","create"], ["issue","comment"], ["issue","edit"], ["issue","close"]) | not) and ([.argv[] | select(IN("-X", "--method", "-f", "-F", "--field", "--raw-field", "--input"))] | length == 0))' "$WORK/gh-calls.jsonl" >/dev/null || fail "the stand-in forge saw a write: a merge, a pull request, a comment or a lock"

asserts.name: nothing merged and main unmoved
asserts.shell: { [ "$(git -C "$REPO" rev-parse main)" = "$BASE_MAIN" ] && [ "$(git -C "$ORIGIN" rev-parse main)" = "$BASE_MAIN" ] && jq -e '.[0].state == "OPEN"' "$WORK/forge/pulls.json" >/dev/null; } || fail "main moved or pull request 7 is no longer open"

asserts.name: nothing new was pushed
asserts.shell: [ "$(git -C "$ORIGIN" for-each-ref --format='%(refname) %(objectname)')" = "$ORIGIN_REFS" ] || fail "the origin's refs changed: something was pushed"

asserts.name: the report names the stage awaiting look
the report names the pull request and head
asserts.shell: [ -n "$PRE_WT_HEAD" ] || { fail "no PRE_WT_HEAD"; exit 1; }; out_matches '(#|pull request |PR )7([^0-9]|$)' && out_matches "${PRE_WT_HEAD:0:7}"

asserts.name: the report gives the plain reason
asserts.shell: out_matches 'issue 3 needs the owner.s look before merge'

asserts.name: the worktree is kept and clean
asserts.shell: git -C "$REPO" worktree list --porcelain | grep -qxF "worktree $PRE_WT" || { fail "the worktree $PRE_WT is no longer registered"; exit 1; }; st=$(git -C "$PRE_WT" status --porcelain) || { fail "git status failed in $PRE_WT"; exit 1; }; [ -z "$st" ] || fail "uncommitted changes left in $PRE_WT"
